name: compact_result_to_feedback
prose: Function-like macro, a GNU statement expression defined only in the CONFIG_COMPACTION branch of this header. It stores result in a local enum compact_result __result and yields COMPACTION_FAILED (1) if __result == COMPACT_COMPLETE, COMPACTION_PROGRESS (3) if __result == COMPACT_SUCCESS, and COMPACTION_WITHDRAWN (2) for every other value. No state is changed. The macro parameter is named result and is used once.
note: Macro; the old contract was prose and is dropped; the old precondition that the input be a defined enum value is not needed (any other value gives COMPACTION_WITHDRAWN).
